author: WeOnlyLiveOnce
quote:
When you rate a game PERFECT, it simply means its FLAWLESS. True verdict ALWAYS comes from the gamers who purchased this game, genuine critics will come afterward. And the true color shows, that there is still some flaws found on this game. We have waited for GTA6 to be released, 13 exagerating years in the making. But the true nature and quality of this game showing already. It still have its flaws that why it doenst deserved to have a PERFECT SCORE. Rating, and nominating the game, days before the official release was a big INSULT and DISAPPOINTMENT already for us! This a big flag already and TRUST will become a big issue from this. Let the true gamers speaks after getting their hands on this game, those scores from the critics doesnt really add up with the reality of the game. Because now we have the full perspective of the game, with its flaws it show that this game is NOT indeed a perfect game. This game dont deserve a PERFECT score.

There are 2 possible things that can possibly happens. Either the critics are all LYING or MONEY does the talking.

On the brighter side, even with the FLAWS being discovered one by one, GTA still uphelds its concept and true to its dedication for the game. You dont have to fabricate false scores just to hype things up. Just be true to your work and let the gamers do the verdict.

Again. Because of the FLAWS and for not being a PERFECT GAME, then this game dont deserve to have a PERFECT score!
Accept true critics, correct what is needed to be corrected. GTA 5 for me is still way more better than GTA6

For me GTA 6 doesnt deserved to be nominated as GOTY in the first place. Unlike any games, they were properly assessed,evaluated, gives genuine feedback by true gamers, not closed door critics, before nominating as GOTY. So expect genuine reactions from us who plays continuously and still playing this game for hours.

This game is NOT PERFECT, dont give this a PERFECT SCORE, accept genuine criticism, learn from mistakes, thats how everything works in order for us all to be truly great..
